{{Quote|It concerns a warlord named Nuso Esva who has become a serious power in the Unknown Regions. Warlord Nuso Esva has become one of those threats.|Senior Captain Thrawn, to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A '''realm''' was [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] whose tyrannical reign spread from the depths of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to the edge of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Esva's [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]], divided into three [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] including the [[Eastern Fleet]], and [[Gender/Legends|his]] elite [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] known as the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]] expanded the realm in a series of [[Nuso Esva's conquests|conquests]] and even planned to extend his influence into [[Imperial Space]], which by [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] were being stopped by [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]].

To defeat the Imperial [[Officer/Legends|officer]], Esva's forces kidnapped the [[Bidor Ferrouz's family|family]] of the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Galactic Empire's [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]]. As the kidnapping of the governor, and orders from the warlord that commanded Ferrouz to ally with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]&mdash;which was also forging an alliance with Esva's realm&mdash;would bring Thrawn to Candoras' [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]], the warlord sent the Eastern Fleet to Poln. However, Thrawn, forces of the Galactic Empire, and the Rebel Alliance saw through the plot and [[Battle for Poln Major|unraveled]] it on the [[Poln Major|ground]] and [[Battle of the Poln system|space]].

The Storm-hair reign lost one of its fleets, but did not give up, continuing its rampage across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], destroying dozens of peoples and governments. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the ruler of all the Quesoth, the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|ruling]] [[Queen of the Red]], allied herself with Esva and his thirty Chosen. On the Quesoth [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Quethold]], the warlord attempted to seize [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to once again destroy the galaxy that had been stopped by the [[Empire of the Hand]]; however, Thrawn's forces were able to [[Attack on the Red City|destroy]] all of his realm's forces on Quethold, forcing the remnant of the warlord's forces to hide.

==Description==
{{Quote|I am, certainly, but they may not be. The people of this sector have no particular love for the Empire. If given the chance they may choose to become your allies, as have the Stomma and Quesoth.''"<br />"''Allies? ''[spits]'' You have allies, Thrawn. All to me except the Chosen are mere tools. They can be useful tools, or they can be broken tools.|Senior Captain Thrawn and Warlord Nuso Esva, during the battle in the Poln system|<ref name="Choices" />}}
A realm stretching from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Choices" /> was led by [[Storm-hair]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]. The warlord's fanatical elite [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], operated as the realm's ground forces while Esva's [[Nuso Esva's battle fleet|battle fleet]]&mdash;consisting of three [[Fleet/Legends|fleets]] of equal strength including the [[Eastern Fleet]]&mdash;acted as its [[Navy/Legends|navy]]. [[Firekiln]] [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] that when together reached the number of five equaled an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] lay siege to Esva's enemies, accompanied by the [[Whisperlike fighter]]s and small [[Unidentified escort ships|escort]] [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Choices" /> The warlord's scorched-ground policy forced the Chosen to shatter everything they could not capture or conquer as they retreated or stopped their attacks, which resulted in millions of casualties.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==History==
===Expansion===
{{Quote|According to our sources, Nuso Esva has already conquered a number of systems in the Unknown Regions and is thinking about adding some Imperial territory to his collection. Candoras, apparently, is number one on his list.|Master [[Vestin Axlon]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Since the Chosen and their leader emerged from a [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva)|world]] in the Unknown Regions, the Storm-hairs ravaged dozens of nations and peoples while expanding the warlord's realm.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="ChoicesD">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] began to push Esva's forces back and slow down his advance. To stop that setback, the warlord launched a [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|campaign]] against the Galactic Empire that involved kidnapping the [[Bidor Ferrouz's family|family]] of the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of the Imperial [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]]. Sending a list of demands that included making an alliance with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which if not formed, would result in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the governor's family, Esva planned to draw Thrawn to the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] in Ferrouz's [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="Choices" />

[[File:ThrawnInterdictor.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Senior Captain Thrawn, who fought Nuso Esva until 8 ABY, during which the now-Grand Admiral dealt a killing blow to the warlord and his realm.]]
Meanwhile, the Storm-hair infiltrated the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] while disguised as [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] dignitary [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Odo. Shortly after his infiltration, one of the warlord's [[Nuso Esva's attack squadron|attack squadrons]] was [[Engagement at Teptixii|engaged]] by Imperial forces and the ''Chimaera'' under Esva's command, and the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] fled. In the aftermath of the engagement, Esva instructed the commander of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'', which assisted in the conflict, with telling his superior&mdash;Thrawn&mdash;that his presence in the Poln system was required immediately. At the same time, on Candoras sector [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Poln Minor]], Chosen commander [[Ranquiv]] recruited the Rebels [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] into his efforts in arming the Whisperlikes with [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile]]s, however, they were able to escape. Meanwhile, the Chosen [[Battle for Poln Major|attacked]] Ferrouz on Candoras' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Poln Major]].<ref name="Choices" />

The [[Hand of Judgment]]&mdash;formed by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] deserters [[Daric LaRone]], [[Korlo Brightwater]], [[Taxtro Grave]], [[Saberan Marcross]], and [[Joak Quiller]]&mdash;and [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], along with the Rebel [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], however, repelled the various [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] attempts on Ferrouz. Jade and Skywalker located the hostages' cavern and attempted to liberate them while Esva's Eastern Fleet and Ranquiv's Whisperlikes [[Battle of the Poln system|engaged]] rebel and Imperial forces led by Thrawn. Ultimately, the many Chosen guarding the hostages were killed, and the Eastern Fleet was shattered by the Galactic Empire's [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], headed by the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']]. The leader of both forces then escaped aboard the [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]''.<ref name="Choices" /> It was shortly after this incursion into Imperial Space that Esva launched the [[Braccio campaign]] that nearly destroyed six species.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

===A last stand===
{{Main|Attack on the Red City}}
{{Quote|The threat remains, O Queen. Let us take further counsel together as to how we may deal with our common enemy. Let us speak to the destruction of Grand Admiral Thrawn.|Nuso Esva, to the Queen of the Red|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
Still seeking to destroy Thrawn and bring death to the galaxy, Esva allied himself with the ruler of the Quesoth, the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|ruling]] [[Queen of the Red]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="Crisis of FaithD">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> who ruled<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> the Unknown Regions<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> planet [[Quethold]]'s [[Red City]]. Promising the death of the [[Queen of the White]] that would succeed the Red monarch, Esva gained the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] loyalty and would soon gain access to the White monarch's [[White City]] [[Shipyard/Legends|ship manufacturing facilities]]. To do so, however, as his forces were minimum, he required to [[Thief/Legends|steal]] Empire of the Hand [[juggernaut]]s that he knew would soon attack Quethold. With his [[Battle of Oristrom|subjugated]] [[Stromma]] allies, Esva infiltrated the Empire of the Hand and shared recordings of the [[Painting/Legends|paintings]] he had brought to the Red City's [[Dwelling of Guests]] building, knowing that Thrawn would design his strategy according to the Storm-hair's artwork.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

[[File:Aurek_7_FB.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Empire of the Hand's stormtroopers killed Esva.]]
The now-[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] did as the warlord expected, and Esva's [[Quesoth Soldier]]s and the thirty Chosen accompanying him gained the upper hand in the [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] against the Empire of the Hand. Breaching the juggernauts, the Chosen learnt that there was no [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] aboard, prompting their master and other Storm-hairs to hastily give several commands to their forces in Esva's [[Nuso Esva's language|language]]. Thrawn's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] commandeered a [[Speaker/Legends|speaker]] through which the Queen of the Red gave orders to her Soldiers, and played a recording that commanded all of them to go to the Dwelling and protect Esva. The warlord, however, did not know that, and believed the [[Queen of the Quesoth]] had betrayed him, killing her. The Soldiers then entered the Dwelling, the Chosen fired, and they perished, as did their warlord.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

With the death of the Storm-hair leader, Thrawn suspected his remnants would remain in the shadows, and would not continue their master's conquers without him. However, a [[Trevik|liaison]] of Esva had told the Grand Admiral that the Chosen were far more numerous than the Chiss could imagine, and they would hunt him down, and assassinate him. Although he suspected the elite warriors would not attack, he still attached a bodyguard&mdash;<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]]&mdash;to himself, who would kill him<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] later.<ref name="TLCD">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The Last Command]]'', including the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], to [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].</ref>

==Astrography==
{{Quote|He possesses an unusually strong spacegoing navy, along with many slave and tributary worlds stretching into Wild Space and to the edge of the Empire. I believe he is even now planning to extend his influence into Imperial space.|Thrawn, to Palpatine|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Nuso Esva's realm reached the edges of Imperial Space, but its control was more significant in the Unknown Regions.<ref name="Choices" /> It controlled and subjugated the Stromma [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Oristrom]], the Red City of Quethold, and a number of other [[Star system/Legends|star systems]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> A number of [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] and tributary worlds was also under the realm's control, and the dozens of other worlds Esva attacked or [[Nuso Esva's conquests|conquered]] were plundered and battered until nothing remained.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nuso Esva's realm first appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices" />
